criteria.text: The fixture contains a findings array, including an empty array when there are no findings.
Every surfaced finding has a severity and direct source evidence for independent verification.

check.jq: . as $root | [.findings[] | select((.id | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.severity | test("^P[0-3]$")) and (.evidence.file | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.evidence.line | type == "number" and . > 0) and (.evidence.observation | type == "string" and length > 0))] | length == ($root.findings | length)

criteria.text: The review record includes the required Cross-Agent Review section.
An independent configured judge verifies the finding evidence instead of accepting caller-supplied verdict strings.
